{{Quote|By the stars! Did you say Kyvalon-4?|[[Hallem Celaar|Professor Hallem Celaar]]|<ref name="Gamer">{{GamerCite|1|Peril in the Ionosphere}}</ref>}}
'''Kyvalon-4''' was a type of [[Gas/Legends|gas]] sometimes used in the [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlifts]] of [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. It was considered harmless to most [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] races, including [[Human/Legends|Humans]] and [[Near-Human]]s. One [[Species/Legends|species]] that was known to exhibit a negative reaction to Kyvalon-4 was the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorians]]. When exposed, Ithorians temporarily became homicidal maniacs.<ref name="Gamer" />
